{{Quote|The Anoat system? There's not much there.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''Anoat system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located between the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin systems]] on the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]], in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], a subsector of the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained three habitable but inhospitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]]: [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]], [[Deyer/Legends|Deyer]], and [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]], as well as Gentes' [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Belsus/Legends|Belsus]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], the main race, were often used as slaves and laborers.

==History==
{{Quote|They found further subspace communication matching the signature of our search subject. From the moon Belsus in the Anoat system. The Confederacy is here in the force.|Jedi Padawan Rini, telling Flynn Kybo that he found Grievous on Belsus|<ref name="General Grievous 3">[[General Grievous 3|''General Grievous'' 3]]</ref>}}
[[File:TheHuntForHanSolo-TCGADT.png|thumb|left|250px|''Slave I'' prepares to pursue the ''Millennium Falcon'' in the Anoat system.]]

Sometime prior to [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], the eventual founder of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Ecclessis Figg]], mapped the first safe [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route to the Anoat system.<ref name="ActionTidings">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041007bespin2|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 2: That Den o' Human Iniquity}}</ref>

The system was taken under [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] control during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], due to an attack led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Grievous attacked Gentes, the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], eager to take the Ugnaughts as factory laborers. On Belsus, he demonstrated his power to a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] by destroying the population of an entire Ugnaught city. Soon after, a Jedi strike force attempted to assassinate Grievous. During their battle with him, the thermal core of a geothermal plant went critical. The resultant explosions threatened the stability of the moon's surface. Nevertheless, Grievous survived. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] proposed sending a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to the Anoat system and then to [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], in order to counter a planned Separatist attack.

The three planets were abandoned sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Toxic waste infected Anoat and the terraformed waterworld Deyer, forcing the populations to move offworld.

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Rebel [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Risiev Credal]] was supervising a routine patrol through the Anoat system and suddenly jumped to hyperspace without a warning, effectively disappearing. This led many to believe that Credal was a traitor.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] passed through this relatively deserted system while fleeing from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

Sometime prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the elite [[Scythe Squadron/Legends|Scythe Squadron]], a squadron of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], were stationed in the system. Several squadron TIEs were upgraded with more powerful cannons to be able to destroy the system's asteroids.

Anoat was repopulated at some point prior to the establishment of the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], as it was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].
